full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph shows a child with round glasses looking outward from behind an old window. Dark glass and interior shadow fill most of the background, with vague pale reflections and blurred shapes behind the face. The child stands slightly right of center, framed from short light hair to the upper chest. Large circular dark-rimmed glasses surround a steady, solemn gaze directed toward the camera. The small face is softly lit, with pale cheeks, a narrow nose, and closed lips; the dark clothing falls away into the shadow below the chin. At the left edge, a vertical wooden window frame rises from bottom to top, worn and rough along its inner side. A thick horizontal sill crosses the lower part of the image, its chipped paint and layered grain more visible than most of the room. The boy's head is close to the glass, but small spots and soft reflections on the pane create a slight barrier between subject and viewer. The shallow focus keeps the eyes, glasses, and front hair clear while turning the interior beyond into dark haze. Daylight from outside, strongest on the left, illuminates the child's forehead and nose; the far side of the face and clothing stay in quiet gray-black shadow. Grain and mild print wear give the image a tactile analog surface. The composition is direct and spare, with the rectangular window construction enclosing a small bright face against deep darkness. No readable signs or other people appear in the selected frame. The overall photograph feels watchful and tender, using near-monochrome light, aging wood, and a serious direct gaze to hold a brief everyday moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白纪实照片呈现一名戴圆眼镜的孩子，从旧窗后望向外面。深色玻璃和室内阴影填满大部分背景，脸后只有模糊的浅色反光与形状。孩子站在中央略偏右处，从浅色短发到上胸被纳入画框。大圆形深框眼镜围住稳稳的严肃目光，直接看向相机。小脸受柔光照亮，面颊浅亮，鼻梁细，嘴唇闭合；深色衣服从下巴下方退入阴影。左边缘，一道竖木窗框从底到顶升起，内侧磨旧粗糙。厚实水平窗台横过图像下部，剥落油漆与层叠木纹比室内大多数地方更清楚。孩子头靠近玻璃，但玻璃上的小斑点与柔和反射在主体和观者之间形成轻微阻隔。浅景深使眼睛、眼镜和前侧头发清楚，后方室内则化为暗雾。外部日光从左侧最强地照来，提亮额头与鼻梁；远侧面孔和衣服留在安静的灰黑阴影中。颗粒与轻微相纸磨损给影像可触的模拟表面。构图直接而简洁，矩形窗结构把一张小亮脸围在深暗前。所选画面里没有可读标牌或其他人物。整幅照片带着警觉和温柔，以近单色光、老木材和严肃直视留住短暂日常瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white documentary style uses a simple dark enclosure and one softly illuminated focal area. Rectangular framing elements create firm boundaries, while faint glass reflections and shallow focus soften the space behind them. A wide range of charcoal grays preserves detail in weathered material without lifting the background too far from black. Fine grain and modest print wear lend tactile authenticity. Exterior side light models the central volume gently, and small bright reflections remain subordinate to the main gaze or focal surface. Close cropping removes narrative excess and makes the relationship between viewer, pane, and subject immediate. The overall effect is observant and emotionally direct, balancing graphic structure with delicate tonal transitions.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白纪实风格使用简单深色围合和一处柔和受光焦点。矩形围框元素建立坚实边界，微弱玻璃反射与浅景深让其后的空间柔化。宽广炭灰阶保留风化材料细节，却不让背景远离黑色太多。细颗粒与适度相纸磨损增添可触的真实感。外部侧光温和塑造中央体积，小亮反射仍从属于主要视线或焦点表面。近距裁切移去多余叙事，使观者、玻璃与主体的关系立即成立。整体效果观察入微且情感直接，平衡图形结构与纤细调子过渡。
theme_en: A solemn child with round glasses looking through an old window
theme_zh: 一名戴圆眼镜、神情严肃的孩子透过旧窗望出
name: Antanas Sutkus
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
